subject: reasoning
question: I is the father of L. L and K are the children of M. L is the husband of N. O is the husband of K. P is the son of O. How is I related to P?
solution:
Preparing the family tree using the following symbols

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/83adf6b34f0e218dde4887ea242cc7167544bfc9aae7d856eb6cd0466f75bda0.png] 

The family tree diagram is shown below:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/227540be6bef139402fb54bec5607b9a20dfe8c225337b907a099bf203861beb.png] 

According to the diagram,** I** is the '**Maternal Grandfather**' of **P**, i.e. "__**Mother's Father**__" of P 

Hence, the correct answer is '__**Mother's Father**__'
